text:
Ava (PM): Heads-up — Sales and Ops dropped two late asks that could shift next week's roadmap. Can we carve out a short cross‑func slot to deconflict priorities and set the agenda for the RFC reviews? Prefer today or tomorrow. Also we should decide who owns the agenda this week.
Sam (Eng Manager): I can do today after 3pm. If it's just a quick deconflict 25m should be enough.
Diego (SWE): I have an RFC ready for batching improvements that needs either a quick triage or signoff — can we put that on the agenda? ping @Priya for review.
Priya (SWE): I can review but need the doc first. Tomorrow 10:30am works better for me if we do a deeper RFC review.
Ava (PM): Doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/rfc/batching-v2. Sales also wants a tiny "token pricing page" item added — low effort but might reshuffle priorities. Proposal: 25m today at 16:00 for deconflict + agenda owners, then a 45m RFC/triage deep‑dive on Wed.
Marta (Design): If Wed is 45m please reserve ~10m for the prototype walkthrough — need quick design constraints from PM/Eng.
Elena (Product Ops): Quick suggestion: rotate agenda ownership weekly. Trial idea: product owns first half, eng owns second half this month. I'll handle invites if we confirm.
Sam (Eng Manager): :thumbsup: rotation seems reasonable. I'm good for 16:00 today, adding Diego and Priya.
Priya (SWE): 16:00 today works but I have a 16:30 call — 25m is tight but doable.
Diego (SWE): Adding one tech decision item: fallback model routing policy — need a quick go/no‑go from product.
Ava (PM): Sounds good. @Elena please book 25m today at 16:00. Tentative agenda: 1) deconflict late asks (10m) 2) assign owners for RFC triage & deep dive (5m) 3) quick decision on routing policy (10m). Attendees: @Sam @Diego @Priya @Marta.
calendar-bot: Event created — "Crossfunc Deconflict" — 25m — 2026-04-12 16:00 — Guests: Sam, Diego, Priya, Marta — Link: https://calendar.redwood/invite/abc123
Priya (SWE): I added the RFC doc to the calendar invite and will post a 1‑paragraph summary in this thread shortly.
Diego (SWE): I'll prepare a 2‑slide decision memo for the routing item.
Ava (PM): Thanks all. For the Wed 45m RFC deep‑dive, can owners add pre‑reads by EOD tomorrow so we can run efficiently? I'll block Wed 10:30 for that.
Priya (SWE): Will do — posting summary now.
Marta (Design): Added prototype link to the invite.
Elena (Product Ops): Rotation trial started — I'll send recurring invites and capture agenda owners in the invite subject.
Sam (Eng Manager): Great — see you at 16:00.
